faq.q: Does my bot stay online when my phone or computer is disconnected?
faq.a: Yes. Each Ceyo bot operates on its own dedicated cloud machine running 24/7. It executes scheduled tasks, tracks live web updates, and processes data independently of your local internet connection or device power status.

faq.a: Absolutely. You can link your bots directly to individual Telegram chats or invite multiple specialized agents into a group chat, enabling your entire staff to collaborate with AI agents in real time.

faq.q: What languages and local business tasks does Ceyo support?
faq.a: Ceyo supports global languages including English, Spanish, Portuguese, and French, and handles Guyanese business context effortlessly. It excels at web research, data extraction, code generation, routine scheduling, and file management.

faq.q: How do Ceyo agents integrate with my existing software?
